name: Visibility Ordering for Curvilinear Grids
aliases: BFS/DFS Adjacency Graph Sort for Curvilinear Grids
definition: An algorithm to generate a visibility ordering for cells in a curvilinear grid (hexahedra) to support semi-transparent rendering, using a combination of undirected breadth-first search and directed depth-first searches on the adjacency graph.
summary: Visibility Ordering for Curvilinear Grids generates back-to-front cell order for semi-transparent rendering by combining BFS and DFS on adjacency graphs to handle non-convex volumes without decomposition.
